condition: native shell purified from T. maritima with native FLP C-terminal targeting peptide bound (3DKT); recombinant WT shell coexpressed with native FLP cargo in E. coli (7MU1)
source: Sutter et al. 2008; LaFrance et al. 2021
notes:
Canonical WT T=1 assembly. Sutter et al. 2008 directly reported 60 shell subunits, T=1 icosahedral symmetry, a 23-24 nm 
shell diameter, and a 2-2.5 nm shell thickness. PDB 3DKT contains the native 8-residue C-terminal targeting peptide of FLP (Q9WZP3) bound to the shell; full FLP cargo was not resolved in that structure. LaFrance et al. 2021 later used cryo-EM to characterize recombinant FLP-loaded TmEnc and demonstrated symmetry-matched association of FLP decamers with shell fivefold axes; PDB 7MU1 represents the corresponding WT shell structure.
